source_notes: CU codes M01..M08 are transcribed from the official NOSS 'Training Hours Summary' for Level 4, which prints them against the competency-unit titles. The CoCU extract we first worked from has a blank CU Code column, and an earlier version of this graph used C01..C08 by analogy with the Level 3 sibling — that was a guess and it was wrong. Local copy: raw/noss-character/fb018-45-L4-training-hours-OFFICIAL.pdf (Jennifer's Drive, owner jennifer@character.com.mx).

The NOSS code year (2012) is not printed in the CoCU text; it is inferred from the sibling FB-018-3:2012 document and the fb018-45 filename. If a different year is found in the cover page of the original PDF, update noss_code accordingly.
CoCU p.12 numbers performance criteria of C06 WA3 as 3.1, 3.3, 3.2 — out of order as printed. All three are transcribed in the order they appear in the source; the sequence is not corrected.
CoCU p.14 skips C08 WA3 criterion 3.2 — printed criteria are 3.1 then 3.3. No 3.2 appears in the printed standard; both are transcribed as printed.
